short_description: Build, maintain, and support partner system integrations based on each partner's requirements.
description: Engineered the complete foundational infrastructure, development lifecycle, and tooling for a new partner integration, ensuring the secure, reliable display of energy plans.
Built automated alerting and monitoring workflows to detect integration errors proactively, and drove incidents to resolution with detailed tickets and immediate code fixes.
Defined project scope and requirements by conducting in-depth reviews of partner API documentation, understanding the technical requirements, and coordinating cross-organizational meetings.

Engineered developer tooling to automate AWS S3 and DynamoDB data workflows, improving data verification and testing velocity; it was quickly adopted into the team's development workflow and CI/CD pipeline.
Used AI coding agents (Claude Code) in daily development to speed up implementation, testing, and code review.
Mentored mid-level and senior engineers to speed up their onboarding onto the core system.

short_description: Maintained and enhanced a microservices-based video-on-demand (VOD) platform.
description: Maintained the Go microservices behind core VOD processing (Audio, Video, Subtitles, Media Assets, and DRM) and monitored system health to ensure continuous and stable operation.
Implemented comprehensive automated testing within the CI/CD framework, enforcing quality control for microservice deployments and preventing issues from reaching production.
Applied continuous static code analysis and refactoring, raising code quality scores across VOD services.
Led new coworkers through the end-to-end VOD encoding pipeline training and comprehensive quality assurance process, directly reducing team ramp-up time and increasing overall productivity.

short_description: Optimized loan management system and on-site inspection APIs with enhanced security.
description: Architected and deployed a private API for construction loan management, integrating on-site inspection functionality and adhering to the Open API Specification and architecture's best practices principles.
Significantly optimized API call efficiency for credential management, resulting in a 50% reduction in CPU usage.
